cases: Minimized close preserves last usable state

limitations: Hosted Windows Server 2025 and Edge automation, without human desktop/UAC interaction.
Physical monitor removal and mixed-DPI hardware were not exercised. Off-screen recovery uses a deliberately invalid saved position; monitor cases also use deterministic bounds.
The user Microsoft account, organization browser policies, Chrome guest mode and legacy Windows were not reproduced.
Live inventory/report collection was not performed; original collector/wrapper/icon provenance passes.
Focus is a synthetic DOM event after a real wait. Native offline/HTTP/rate-limit/cache/security cases use deterministic responses.
SHA-256 validates bytes, not publisher signing. Repository-level immutable locking remains disabled; workflow overwrite guards remain.

initial_upgrade_failure.cause: The PowerShell test mutated nested RECT value-type fields without assigning the complete RECT. The negative control returns LegacyNestedWriteValue=0; the corrected request/independent native probe and saved-file bounds all match.
